ayahs.tj: هَلْ أَتَـٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَـٰشِيَةِ ١
ayahs.en: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?

ayahs.tj: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَـٰشِعَةٌ ٢
ayahs.en: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,
Working [hard] and exhausted.
They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.
They will be given drink from a boiling spring.

ayahs.ar: لَيسَ لَهُم طَعامٌ إِلّا مِن ضَريعٍ
ayahs.tj: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍ ٦
ayahs.en: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant

ayahs.ar: لا يُسمِنُ وَلا يُغنى مِن جوعٍ
ayahs.tj: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍ ٧
ayahs.en: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.

ayahs.tj: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاعِمَةٌ ٨
ayahs.en: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.
With their effort [they are] satisfied
In an elevated garden,

ayahs.tj: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَـٰغِيَةً ١١
ayahs.en: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.
Within it is a flowing spring.
Within it are couches raised high
And cups put in place
And cushions lined up
And carpets spread around.

ayahs.ar: أَفَلا يَنظُرونَ إِلَى الإِبِلِ كَيفَ خُلِقَت
ayahs.tj: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ ١٧
ayahs.en: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?

ayahs.tj: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ ١٨
ayahs.en: And at the sky - how it is raised?
And at the mountains - how they are erected?
And at the earth - how it is spread out?

ayahs.tj: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ ٢١
ayahs.en: So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder.
You are not over them a controller.

ayahs.tj: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ ٢٣
ayahs.en: However, he who turns away and disbelieves -
Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.

ayahs.tj: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ ٢٥
ayahs.en: Indeed, to Us is their return.

ayahs.tj: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم ٢٦
ayahs.en: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.
